objs.name: policy
objs.description: A company-wide regulation and process at strategic level (e.g. code of conduct, travel expenses policy, ICS policy, process and organizational structure)

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code assigned to the document type

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each type

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name of the policy

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Documents, master data, or other entities referenced by the policy

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications relevant to the policy

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies for which the policy applies

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational areas where the policy is valid

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The creator and registered author of the policy

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional person with change rights beyond the primary author

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person responsible for checking content according to technical and formal aspects

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for approving the policy for distribution

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person translating the policy to another language

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group with read-only access to the policy

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the policy

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the policy becomes valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the policy remains valid

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Duration for which the policy remains valid after release

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups or persons notified by email when released

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons required to confirm acknowledgement

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning while following the main document's release process statuses

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code assigned to the attachment type

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each type

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name of the attachment

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the attachment becomes valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the attachment remains valid

attributes.name: archiving_status
attributes.description: Whether the attachment has been marked for archiving

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be directly published or deleted without affecting the main document version

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or description of the additional information

attributes.name: content_type
attributes.description: Type of content such as brief instructions, photos, or screenshots

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is published or not

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for amending a document created by employees with author rights without affecting the document's content or version history

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Description or title of the proposed change

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The creator of the change proposal

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (pending, implemented, completed)

attributes.name: planned_for_implementation
attributes.description: Whether the proposal is scheduled to amend the document

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned specific roles and access permissions to documents

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the group (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Archive)

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Purpose or scope of the user group

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person with assigned roles and permissions for document management activities

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator)

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: User group to which the user belongs

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated or manually created request to check whether a document should be extended, revised, or invalidated at the end of its validity period

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the validity extension request

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: The date when the document validity expires

attributes.name: extended_validity
attributes.description: New validity period if the document is extended

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date when the request was created

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the override request

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Person who created the override request

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which the document remains archived before physical deletion

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the override request was created

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document and its attachments

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the reactivation request

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Person who created the reactivation request

attributes.name: document_selected
attributes.description: The document selected for reactivation

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the reactivation was confirmed

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A special user group with read access to archived documents even after all other authorizations have been revoked

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the archive group

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that may be referenced by or linked to documents for process-specific organization

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the process

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description of the process

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A department or division within the company that may be associated with documents

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the organizational unit

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description or scope of the organizational unit

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk entity that may be linked to relevant documents for risk management purposes

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name or description of the risk

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Details about the risk

objs.name: it_application

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the IT application

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description or purpose of the application

objs.name: template

attributes.description: The document type this template is associated with

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: File format of the template (e.g., MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

attributes.name: metadata_fields
attributes.description: TAG technology fields for automated metadata insertion

objs.name: language_version

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language of this version

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the language version (draft, released)

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person responsible for the translation

attributes.name: reviewer

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for approving the translated version

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to document versions

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who applied the signature

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was applied

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role of the signer in the release process (Author, Reviewer, Releaser)

attributes.name: document_version
attributes.description: The version of the document being signed

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status indicating the signature has been documented

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A record of all changes, actions, and signatures applied to a document throughout its lifecycle

attributes.name: event
attributes.description: Description of the audit event

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the event

attributes.name: user
attributes.description: User who performed the action

attributes.name: changes
attributes.description: Details of what was changed

attributes.description: User who confirmed the acknowledgement

attributes.name: document_version
attributes.description: Version of the document acknowledged

attributes.name: confirmed_date
attributes.description: Date when the acknowledgement was confirmed

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the acknowledgement (pending, confirmed)

attributes.name: email_notification_sent
attributes.description: Whether the user was notified by email about the acknowledgement requirement

objs.name: distribution_list

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution (email notification or acknowledgement required)

attributes.name: recipients
attributes.description: User groups or persons included in the distribution

attributes.name: read_authorization
attributes.description: Whether listed recipients automatically receive read access to the document

attributes.name: role

attributes.name: document_list
attributes.description: Documents displayed on the dashboard

attributes.name: filter_parameters
attributes.description: Selection criteria for filtering documents

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Title of the report

attributes.name: role

attributes.name: selection_parameters
